subject: Re: appointment timing
text: Hi, thanks for checking, and sorry I left it late to reply. I have been meaning to sort out the appointment, but something shifted in the last day or two. My priorities have shifted because my family has needed more help this week, so my usual evening study block is now moving around at short notice. That does not mean I want to cancel forever, only that I may need to change the time and meet somewhere closer to the campus library. If you still prefer tomorrow morning, I could come early, though I would need to leave before the next session starts. Otherwise Thursday after lunch might be calmer for everyone, including my cousins who are suddenly everywhere. Let me know which suits you, and if you already booked something on my account, tell me what it was so I can try to undo it without wasting your effort. I appreciate your patience, and I will be easier to pin down next week.
